question.text: Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE) on the balance sheet are shown at:

answer.text: Historical cost net of accumulated depreciation

explanation.text: The Logic: PPE is shown at historical cost less accumulated depreciation. IndAS 16 allows revaluation but the default is cost model. The Trap: PPE is not marked to market daily like securities. Replacement and liquidation values are different concepts. Cross-Exam Context: Balance sheet items tested in NISM XV Ch 8.
